title: Glowing Rift Waterfall
description: A dramatic nighttime landscape featuring a powerful waterfall cascading between two massive dark rock formations. Bright red glowing energy cracks and lightning-like patterns spread across the rocks around the waterfall, illuminating the scene against a starry night sky with pine trees and a calm reflective pool at the base.
